description: This file defines a React component 'DatetimePlugin' that integrates with the Lexical editor to insert date and time nodes into the editor content based on specific commands. It registers commands for inserting date, time, and datetime with formatted headings and manages editor state updates.

classes.name: DatetimePlugin
classes.description: React functional component that registers commands to insert formatted date/time headings into a Lexical editor instance.

methods.name: DatetimePlugin
methods.description: Main React component that sets up command registrations for date/time insertion in Lexical editor.
